nativeState.importantInterpretation: The Logic 12.3 default insertion is not neutral and is not an isolated bit-depth reduction. It combines +3 dB Drive, 8-bit Resolution, Clip mode at 0 dB, 100% wet Mix, and 1x Downsampling.

modelContextSummary: Partial direct Logic 12.3 build-6674 evidence at 48 kHz mono: the observed Default Preset was Clip, +3 dB Drive, 8-bit Resolution, 1x Downsampling, 100% Mix, and 0 dB Clip Level. Three settled bypass renders matched the fixture PCM exactly; three settled active renders plus one post-reload render shared one PCM hash. First-transition renders differed briefly, so settled repeats are required. Fold, Wrap, parameter grids, downsampling above 1x, stereo, other rates, musical preference, and Apple's exact implementation remain unmeasured.

input.sourceUnchangedEvidence: The fixture file retained the suite-manifest SHA-256. Logic's project-local WAVE copy has different container bytes but retained identical decoded PCM after the run; see artifacts/project-copy-analysis.json.

documented_default_and_bypass_path.evidence: Default state captured before save and after reload; three settled manual-bypass renders matched the fixture PCM exactly.

every_discrete_mode_model_algorithm_and_.evidence: Fold and Wrap were not rendered; only Clip was measured.

bounded_continuous_parameter_grid_with_i.evidence: Only the observed Default Preset values were measured.

reported_and_measured_latency_polarity_g.evidence: Zero-lag correlation, polarity, level, peak, and exact frame count were measured on the amplitude fixture. An impulse-based latency/tail lane was not run.

three_identical_renders_for_repeatabilit.evidence: Three settled active renders and one post-reload active render share one decoded PCM hash; three settled bypass renders share the source PCM hash.

save_reload_state_and_source_hash_verifi.evidence: The UI state was reobserved after save/reload, the post-reload output matched the settled pre-save PCM exactly, the fixture file retained its manifest hash, and the project-local source copy retained identical decoded PCM.

stateTransitionFindings.finding: The first bypass export after a state transition differed only within samples 1 through 1023; samples from 1024 onward matched the fixture.
stateTransitionFindings.consequence: A native-effect empirical run must discard initial renders until at least three settled decoded-PCM repeats agree.

stateTransitionFindings.finding: The first active export differed from the settled active result only within samples 2 through 478.
stateTransitionFindings.consequence: The first active render is preserved for audit but excluded from steady-state transfer claims.

stateTransitionFindings.finding: Whole-file WAVE hashes varied across settled repeats while decoded PCM hashes were identical.
stateTransitionFindings.consequence: Repeatability is evaluated using both immutable whole-file hashes and decoded-PCM hashes; PCM identity is the signal criterion.

stronglySupported: At the observed Logic 12.3 Default Preset state, the settled bypass path is sample-transparent for this 48 kHz mono PCM24 fixture.
At that same state, three settled pre-save renders and one post-reload render are decoded-PCM identical.
The observed default state reaches digital full scale and suppresses the quietest ladder material because it is an active +3 dB, 8-bit, Clip-mode process rather than a neutral insertion.
inferences: The delayed first nonzero output is consistent with coarse amplitude quantization mapping low-amplitude samples to zero; this run does not identify Apple's exact quantizer rounding law.
notEstablished: The exact private transfer function or quantizer implementation.
Any setting other than the observed Default Preset.
Downsampling alias behavior because Downsampling was 1x.
Stereo, other sample rates, tails, impulse latency, automation, musical preference, or universal production suitability.
